enableHint: Enabled (disabled models are excluded from task execution)
forcedToolChoiceHint: Allows tool_choice=required; disable for endpoints with always-on thinking (e.g. Kimi)
noModels: No models yet. Use "Manual Add" or "Browse Remote Models" above.
noProviders: No providers yet, click top-right to add
priorityDesc: Drag model cards to adjust priority. Higher-ranked models are used first.
noConfiguredModels: No models configured. Please add models in "Model Config" first.
noModelsOfType: No models of this type. Please add in "Model Config".
priorityNote: Priority note: When the system needs a "{{type}}" model, it tries from top to bottom, preferring the first-ranked model. Drag cards to reorder.
modelNameHint: Leave empty to use the model ID
noRemoteModels: Could not fetch remote model list. Please check provider config.
autoConfigNotFound: Model not in database, cannot auto-configure (set manually)
connManagedByProvider: API URL and key are provider-level; edit them in Provider Config above
endpointAutoHint: Protocol is auto-detected when the API URL ends with /v1/responses or /v1/chat/completions
effortHint: Follow global = use the level injected by Mind/task; auto-downgrades if the endpoint rejects it

modelFields.request_paramsHint: Top-level request params; merged last after construction, same-name keys win here
modelFields.extra_bodyHint: Merged into the request body; applied last (after thinking adaptation), same-name keys win here
modelFields.extra_headersHint: Merged last into HTTP headers; can override auth headers (same-name keys win here)
modelFields.thinkingHint: Declares how thinking effort maps into the request body: param target field (reasoning_effort / thinking.type), map level mapping, on enable value, off disable value; leave empty for generic passthrough
modelFields.chat_protocolHint: Mind still uses Chat Completions by default; responses bridges internally
modelFields.temperatureHint: Leave empty = not sent, model default applies
modelFields.builtin_toolsHint: Provider server-side built-in tools (comma-separated); same-name local tools are overridden. Common: web_search, web_extractor, code_interpreter, t2i_search, i2i_search

subagents.desc: Unified sub-agent profiles: each profile binds an ordered model pool; delegate_task with agent_name uses that profile (pool order is priority, falls through on unavailable models).
subagents.usageHint: Built-in difficulty tiers easy/medium/hard and custom profiles share one registry: difficulty 1/2/3 is sugar for the built-ins, agent_name=easy also works. Changes take effect immediately.
subagents.builtinHint: delegate_task difficulty 1/2/3 maps to easy/medium/hard; an exhausted tier falls down to the lower tier.
subagents.poolEmpty: No models in this profile (difficulty routing falls to lower tiers or the default model)
subagents.customHint: Create "name → model" bindings for common work types (e.g. researcher); use via delegate_task agent_name.
subagents.nameHint: Starts with a letter; letters/digits/underscore/hyphen only, ≤32 chars; easy/medium/hard are reserved for built-ins
subagents.empty: No custom profiles yet; create one above
